verdict.rationale: Buzz ships its own self-hosting distributions: a single-node/VPS compose bundle and a live Helm chart on GHCR whose production profile uses external managed Postgres/Redis/S3. Operators can therefore place their relay and its data wherever they deploy it. The evidence never describes region or residency selection as a feature, and there is no documented region choice for operator-hosted shared infrastructure. Missing for 10: an explicit residency/region selection feature, a region picker for hosted workspaces, and documentation or independent corroboration framing self-hosting as data-residency control.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)

citations.quote: Run your own relay for one community, or let an operator host thousands on shared infrastructure — same OSS codebase, same URL-is-your-workspace experience either way.
The project lives in one place, and that place is yours.
Production (default): External managed Postgres/Redis/S3, secrets.existingSecret:, no chart-side autogen, HA-capable (replicaCount ≥ 2)
